_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Jëfandikukat Sàpp bi ci ab {width}×{height} këmbët.
Yaa ngone sàpp {player_id} bi. Lawa yu wóor: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (wa w/s/a/d).
Jëm kanam: bàyyi màgg ak màgg jëfandikukat bi, jël màgg ñaare ak màgg ñaare (limite {max_turns} jëf).

game_action.invalid_death: Njaan {player_id} dee na ndax jàll bu amul njariñ.

outcome.all_dead_simul: Ay jaan yépp dee ci benn waxtu.
outcome.outlived: Njiit bi moo gën a dund ñi ci des.
outcome.turn_limit: Limite jëf bi ñaaree - màgg ñaare moo gënëe màgg.
